name: Intel
description: Intel designs PC and server processors (Core, Xeon) and also runs its own chip factories. The filings treat it as two companies in one: Intel Products (the chip designers, selling to PC makers and data centers) and Intel Foundry (the factories, which make nearly all of Intel Products' chips and are trying to win outside customers). The product side earned a 26% operating margin on $49.1B of 2025 revenue; the foundry side lost $10.3B on $17.8B of mostly internal revenue. Intel also owns Mobileye and sold 51% of Altera in September 2025.
